dialogue.line: You ever so much as scrape your knee... Get it covered up straight away. Otherwise they'll come to you like moths to a flame.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You walk with a cane, Otokar?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Petra
dialogue.line: Yes... Although we're not quite as close as we used to be.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Petra
dialogue.line: The guy you beat up earlier. Who was he?

q002_church_premysl: We shouldn't be here. We shouldn't be doing this.

dialogue.speaker: Premysl
dialogue.line: You fear for others. I understand. But... If we don't fight, if we just obey, we're all doomed.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Your wife died in the plague. You never had children.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: You won't get it out of him. He's gone already. Fuck. Fuck!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: My father, did you see him? Ludwig? Ludwig!

dialogue.speaker: 4E55AD8C4A38CF9A32DEEA828F4DC8AC
dialogue.line: Hold on, Ludwig. We'll help you.

q001_04_survivor_gpl: No... Argh... No, oh Lord, no...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You need to put the knife down.

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: You – you objected to magic. Swore you'd never have anything to do with it!

dialogue.speaker: q101_Leonica
dialogue.line: You! You and your sweet words. 'Don't you want to taste forbidden fruit? Bend reality with mere words?'

dialogue.speaker: 11E013224482A7A7DD362983DB633984
dialogue.line: Don't you know you can't trust the Devil?

vt_e: Da vires, defende me a periculo...
I won't give up! Not now!

dialogue.speaker: SQ710.Gavril
dialogue.line: You want to slay them... Am I right?

dialogue.speaker: Bakir
dialogue.line: You there! Finish this for us.

sq710_dlg_gmpl_KirilComments: Ugh, when will this finally start?

dialogue.line: You may surrender your weapon now. We're among friends, aren't we?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You seem pretty sure of yourself.

dialogue.speaker: SQ710.Sever
dialogue.line: Yes, he does. But don't count on that honour being yours.

dialogue.speaker: Bakir
dialogue.line: [clears throat] Now, where was I? Ah, yes. I'd do anything for my friends! I share everything with them - food, drink, all my wealth!

dialogue.speaker: SQ710.Farkas
dialogue.line: [gasp] What are you...? You bloody idiot...

dialogue.speaker: SQ710.Sever
dialogue.line: You bathe them in gold, Lord Boyar!

dialogue.speaker: Bakir
dialogue.line: You there! Finish this for us.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You seem quite familiar with their habits.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You try something, we'll find out how a roast kobold dinner smells. You hear me?

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: [sniff] Dead Wrongs! Silly, silly! Yes, yes! We eat! [panting]

dialogue.line: Oh, a dinner invitation, is it?

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: Wrong! They want wrong! Break all! Grr, grr!

dialogue.line: You smell tasty! We try eat! Try, try! But fail...

dialogue.line: You will show us where Isbrand is?

dialogue.speaker: B052EDC044AC1FA9609A0C9D8EB7B0FB
dialogue.line: I stand by what I said. No deal.

dialogue.speaker: 61A75ABC4DE607C34002348B936D3AB7
dialogue.line: We're fine on our own, as you can see.

dialogue.speaker: 94A2E54B4B11EC11B4916581DDECEBE0
dialogue.line: Why would we ever trust you?

dialogue.speaker: 22B2F1DE4DCA1EC88A82AA934B2FA32B
dialogue.line: You're right, let's find the way on our own.

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: Vrakhiri no hide! Vrakhiri fight! Yes, yes!!! Look! There! Ready!

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: Wrongs still in cave! Must kill! Yes, yes!

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Oof, the big fuckers were 'you' before, you realise that, right?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [sigh] You're too stupid to talk to. We're done wasting time here.

dialogue.speaker: 7491F02E459EFF608FC2BABCC203A758
dialogue.line: One step and you're just as dead.

dialogue.speaker: AA34E81C413FB68D07AF02A831589167
dialogue.line: You said it wasn't a trap.

dialogue.speaker: DFF9A83144729ECD88959DA6878E6DAE
dialogue.line: You want to die? Go ahead, we'll help.

dialogue.speaker: 232D59094279C2AA83F9A3AE9380D987
dialogue.line: You will lose your bond if you eat it.

dialogue.speaker: 27A2AB144D21BCF31EB92C9B15091E90
dialogue.line: You're too stupid to talk to.

dialogue.line: More vrakhiri?! Not with Brencis! No, no! Kill!

dialogue.line: Your soul's doomed. At least make something of it...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Not just yet. I'll be back, soon.

dialogue.line: You... You haven't changed a bit. Even your clothes are the same.

dialogue.line: Tonis! Oh, Coen, you found him!

dialogue.line: You walk both in the sun and by the moon's pale light. You see more than others. You can be trusted.

dialogue.speaker: SQ720.PixiesKid
dialogue.line: You're not listening! I said I don't want to!

dialogue.speaker: SQ720.LittleBrother
dialogue.line: Yes. A plaything for fucking monsters!

dialogue.speaker: SQ720.LittleBrother
dialogue.line: Well, it's tough. Two mouths to feed now.

dialogue.line: Take this. For you and Heile.

dialogue.line: I was able to find one of the components for the armour.

dialogue.speaker: AE7801B246997EF47A841AAD598CAD58
dialogue.line: I'd like to know more about you.

dialogue.line: I've found this silver blade shard...

dialogue.speaker: F0056970436695D4ACC98A8D5AC495E3
dialogue.line: It seems like it. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 0801996E40CABEA81086AAB827E0D93B
dialogue.line: Your horns... why are they missing?

dialogue.speaker: Uriash_Blacksmith
dialogue.line: You master of armour. It bind. It protect!

dialogue.line: You never told me your name.

dialogue.speaker: 4888271546F29AAD27A9A7B1D773A8AD
dialogue.line: Not sure if I'm ready yet.

dialogue.speaker: Uriash_Blacksmith
dialogue.line: We close! I hear song! I hear blood!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Why is your steel so good?

dialogue.line: You think my tongue is foul? Come around from the other side, I'll show you foul.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB108.Onlooker02
dialogue.line: What?! How dare you! Did you hear what he just said?!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Why did they put you in a pillory?

dialogue.speaker: 34149C0A44E45F8BFA7C61A920A66D6A
dialogue.line: I'm sorry, Vasil. I shouldn't have.

dialogue.speaker: 99B4166142A43080E8CDF3A766FFE97A
dialogue.line: Not easy to break - what do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: 911AB22A46E8FA70DD93ADA43DE65DBE
dialogue.line: Why did they put you in a pillory?

dialogue.speaker: Vasil
dialogue.line: That what the old man said when you were born?

dialogue.line: Your elder asks something of you – and you're too busy?

dialogue.line: You could say we had a little disagreement, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: Atanas
dialogue.line: You're telling me how to raise my own son? Is that right?

dialogue.speaker: Vasil
dialogue.line: You heard my old man, Coen. Mind your own business.

dialogue.line: What did he do to me?!

dialogue.line: We'll search every nook and cranny, if need be.

dialogue.line: Your father, he warned me. Told me this would happen. Shit, shit, shit.

dialogue.line: The entrance has collapsed. We're trapped.

dialogue.line: I'm fine, it's just... My head...

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: You won't get it out of him. He's gone already. Fuck. Fuck!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: My father, did you see him? Ludwig? Ludwig!

dialogue.speaker: 4E55AD8C4A38CF9A32DEEA828F4DC8AC
dialogue.line: Hold on, Ludwig. We'll help you.

dialogue.speaker: 4FE34B944F79D827AFBD00A40B5A8C32

dialogue.line: They're all bloodied, torn... I can't tell.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: So? The clothes – they're your mother's handiwork?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're scared. I get it. I'm scared too.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: [cough] So you can drink my blood? [cough] Like you did Kostel's?

dialogue.speaker: 434622D04DD24D03F60E5994B31A2E44
dialogue.line: We can still save my father.

dialogue.speaker: A60238DB4D73D83F3C77C1B23B5435A0
dialogue.line: You're afraid – I get it. I am, too.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You'll make up for it later.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: Wait. Ugh... Before you go, I need to tell you something.

dialogue.speaker: 4C247BE3424C020A372020852360229C
dialogue.line: I'm not wasting another second on your bullshit.

dialogue.speaker: 003697104DC2936455BD749D5B984B41
dialogue.line: Then at least I'll die with my family.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: Can't say that I do, no.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Wait. Can you hear that? Pounding... Like a heartbeat.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: More footprints. Going even further down.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: All this... For a few lumps of ore. What was the point?

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: Sometimes it doesn't take much to tip the scales.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: I didn't think it would turn out this way.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Layos. He was meant to get married this autumn...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Didn't even fight back. Never had the chance.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: We had to try. It was – now or never, right?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Fuck. What a terrible way to die.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: Must be rats. They live in the lower levels.

q001_vladimir_gmpl_default_ns_FG: What are you doing? Leave this junk be.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: You're wounded, exhausted. No wonder you're seeing things.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: We're losing time. You know it.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: Your father... I was wondering, did the two of you talk earlier?

dialogue.speaker: 4C03817C477ED6D0FACBA8A6EB2E7074
dialogue.line: I see you're eager to stick your neck out.

dialogue.speaker: 241DBCF441D5E7EDE2B724B587C08F8E
dialogue.line: What do you want from my father?

dialogue.speaker: FE75D1C34A30772F7394C9B8A8D133FD
dialogue.line: Why didn't you share your plans with me?

q002_church_vladimir: It'll be over before long. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_Rebel1
dialogue.line: What do you think happened to the scouts?

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: You know he can probably hear you?

dialogue.speaker: 61DD1BE34876EEA8260CF68EF452A5A1
dialogue.line: Ah. Look what the cat dragged in.

dialogue.speaker: 12C8875F433B580D37552688152FA99C
dialogue.line: As usual – you've got more luck than sense.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: You know they nearly got me too, that day? I'd left the mill to go the city, and by the time I got back, he was gone.

dialogue.speaker: 4903AA6C4A1974F269D5468E33C659D1
dialogue.line: Do you know what happened to Mert?

dialogue.speaker: DB9E4C194E03E2ECD82459B4A58CD3D2
dialogue.line: So you're not a part of it?

dialogue.speaker: B060BC354C602F83E3A7949369DDB470
dialogue.line: Why didn't you take part in the voting?

dialogue.speaker: 79F23363469005FC832A8B8651E05D39
dialogue.line: Would you help me with my assignment?

q300_06_07_gmpl_ghost_vlad: A monster! That's what you are!

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: Whoa! Whoa now, stop it! What's going on here?!

dialogue.speaker: Kostel
dialogue.line: I found him sneaking around. Snooping!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're gonna get us all killed.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: You're like a brother to me, you know that.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: You're sticking your nose in other people's business, seems like.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Your name came up. Called you a troublemaker.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: Well, then we're all fucked anyway.

vt_c: Come on, throw a proper punch!
Heh. I'm not going over there.
Let’s see what you’re made of!
Oh, just give it a rest already.
So you expect me to just stand here?
Staring me down won’t save you...
Stop wandering around. We've got something to do.
That's an... unusual way to be.
Turn around before I make you.
Ugh, the ground's all muddy already.
What are you waiting for? Move!

dialogue.speaker: SQ719.Volk
dialogue.line: What are you waiting for? Do something!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Would you please just calm down?!

dialogue.speaker: SQ719.Volk
dialogue.line: Wild mushroom stew. I like to eat well, even when the times are tough!

dialogue.speaker: SQ719.Volk
dialogue.line: Who's there? Pieter? Is that you?

dialogue.speaker: SQ719.Volk
dialogue.line: You enjoy being young, lad. Vrakhiri or not... It'll never be better.

dialogue.speaker: SQ719.Volk
dialogue.line: You're pulling my leg... Seriously? Well, shit.

dialogue.speaker: SQ719.Volk
dialogue.line: Yes, yes, they might know something! Only be careful. All clergymen are greedy little fuckers! Don't tell them too much.

dialogue.speaker: SQ719.Volk
dialogue.line: Well, use this trick, don't use it, frankly, I couldn't care less. But at least try learning it.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You said you'd teach me something...?

dialogue.speaker: SQ719.Volk
dialogue.line: You know, Coen, I've been thinking... The reward we got after Cassel. You think Pieter spent his share?

vt_c: Ah, so that's why my joints were aching.
Ah, you fight just like your father.
Come on, give me your best!
Don't hold back! I can take it!
Gold and plenty of fornication, that's all a man needs.
Hey! I'm the blind one, remember?
How about you take a step back, hm?
I'll hand your arse to you.
Oh, you'll be in so much pain.
Step away from there or I'll fuck you up!

dialogue.line: Let's just hope the knyaz isn't there yet. Come right now!

dialogue.line: Oh, no! Time for Mass already?!

q002_church_zdislav: How's Esme? I hope she'll be all right...

dialogue.speaker: Zdislav
dialogue.line: Your words worry me. Vladimir, he's always been a handful.

dialogue.line: You know the peat bogs? Right by the woods?

dialogue.speaker: 75C0F2B1466F424EBD2DA7A5AD9D6B9C
dialogue.line: I think Vladimir is up to something.

dialogue.speaker: 9904D41E45DE49103AF935A786EC6B08
dialogue.line: My mother – does she have to go to mass tonight?

dialogue.speaker: BA14240A49CBE09245B8B3A734E27D53
dialogue.line: The silver mines – people say they're haunted.

dialogue.speaker: 6449A1484A1F3A646836ACB671A2FE41
dialogue.line: Why does Kuno live in the forest?

vt_c: Don't go where they didn't ask you.
These are difficult times, no doubt.
Think that sword makes you a somebody?

vt_e: Ah, Death is here to claim you. I can feel it.
I shall study your entrails with great interest.
This pales in comparison to my powers.
This place will be your grave.
Yes, exhaust yourself fighting my serfs.
Your blood will make a most potent ingredient.
